SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT C.COURSE_ID FROM COURSE C WHERE 1=1
AND C.COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
GROUP BY C.COURSE_ID )

SELECT C.COURSE_ID AS "courseId", C.COURSE_TITLE AS "courseTitle", C.STATUS AS "status", TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate", TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endDate" FROM COURSE C ORDER BY
C.COURSE_TITLE C.START_DATE C.END_DATE
CASE WHEN C.STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 -- 진행중 WHEN C.STATUS = 'W' THEN 2 -- 예정 WHEN C.STATUS = 'N' THEN 3 -- 종료 ELSE 4 END
C.COURSE_ID
ASC DESC

SELECT C.COURSE_ID, C.COURSE_TITLE, CASE C.STATUS WHEN 'W' THEN '예정' WHEN 'Y' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'N' THEN '종료' END AS STATUS_NAME, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE FROM COURSE C WHERE 1=1
AND C.COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
GROUP BY C.COURSE_ID, C.COURSE_TITLE, C.STATUS, C.START_DATE, C.END_DATE ORDER BY
C.COURSE_TITLE C.START_DATE C.END_DATE C.COURSE_ID
ASC DESC

SELECT COURSE_TITLE, TO_CHAR(START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE, CASE STATUS WHEN 'W' THEN '예정' WHEN 'Y' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'N' THEN '종료' END AS STATUS_NAME FROM COURSE WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
SELECT DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM DEPARTMENT ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_ID ASC
